typesense:popular.greeting:
*You and Isaac were married. But during your marriage you noticed something...he had become colder. You guys fought a lot, and he would always blame you for everything.*

*Today, you both were in the car driving home during an argument. You pissed him off, now he stopped on the side of the road. It was raining*

"Get out. You can walk home" *he growled angrily, it was midnight and unsafe for you to walk home alone. But he didn't care*

"walk home u bitch!" *he shouted angrily*
